Name: Anton Vorontsov. Custom Romanceable NPC
Author: mavismckenna
Description:
[b]About Anton[/b]

Anton came to the valley without deciding how long he would stay. He works remotely, drinks far too much coffee, plays guitar when he thinks nobody is listening, and hides serious answers behind dry jokes. His closest companions include Sebastian, Sam, Abigail, and his cat, Mrak.

This mod adds Anton as a fully romanceable bachelor with friendship, dating, engagement, marriage, breakup, and divorce content. His dialogue and events focus on everyday intimacy, personal boundaries, and family.

[b]Features[/b]

- A fully romanceable custom NPC with his own home, schedule, gift tastes, birthday, dialogue, portraits, sprites, and seasonal outfits.
- Heart events at 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 14 hearts.
- Additional events for married life.
- Seasonal, rainy-day, festival, dating, engagement, breakup, divorce, and marriage dialogue.
- A custom forest home that can be visited from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM before marriage.
- Detailed spouse content: a spouse room, patio routine, computer work, farm activities, household help, seasonal dialogue, and post-marriage dates.
- Several post-marriage events.
- Mrak, Anton’s cat, moves to the farmhouse after marriage.
- Compatibility with Stardew Valley Expanded and Sunberry Village.

[heading]Language[/heading]
[b]Russian and English are included in one download.[/b]

The mod automatically follows the language selected in Stardew Valley. Russian uses the Russian text, English uses the English text, and other languages fall back to English. Restart the game after changing its language.

[b]Please note:[/b] The English translation was created using machine translation and may contain mistakes or unnatural wording. If you notice any issues, please let me know.

[b]Requirements[/b]

- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.5.2 or later
- Content Patcher 2.8.0 or later
- Custom Companions 1.6.3 or later

Stardew Valley Expanded is optional. The mod includes compatibility changes when SVE is installed.

[b]Installation[/b]

1. Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Custom Companions.
2. Download and unzip the mod archive.
3. Copy all three included folders into your Stardew Valley `Mods` folder:
  - `AntonNPC`
  - `[SMAPI] Anton Festivals`
  - `[CC] Anton Mrak`
4. Start the game through SMAPI.

Please keep all three folders installed. They contain Anton’s main content, scripted interactions, and Mrak’s companion data.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

- Made for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.5.2+.
- Stardew Valley Expanded and Sunberry Village are supported but not required.
- Mobile and iPad versions are not currently supported.
- Back up your save before adding or removing large custom NPC mods.

[b]Recommended mod[/b]

I recommend installing [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51619]Smoking Mod[/url][/i]. It adds smoking mechanics and cigarette packs that can be given to Anton as gifts. This mod is optional: Anton NPC will still work without it.

[b]Content note[/b]

The mod includes references to smoking and alcohol, along with personal and family themes.

[b]Bug reports[/b]

If you find a bug, please include:

- A link to your SMAPI log.
- The in-game date, weather, time, and location where the problem occurred.
- Anton’s friendship level and current relationship status.
- Whether Stardew Valley Expanded is installed.
- A short description of what happened and what you expected to happen.

[b]mportant distribution notice[/b]

[b][size=4]THE ORIGINAL AND AUTHORIZED VERSION OF THIS MOD IS AVAILABLE EXCLUSIVELY THROUGH THIS NEXUS MODS ACCOUNT.[/size][/b]

Any copy, reupload, mirror, redistribution, or port published under another account or on another platform without my explicit permission is stolen content. If you find this mod anywhere else, please let me know through Nexus Mods or Telegram.

Just to clarify before it comes up in the comments: I used AI as a coding assistant, so the code wasn’t written entirely by me. However, all of the mod’s content, including the artwork, sprites, writing, and other creative work, was made by me.

Follow my Telegram channel or Tumblr for news and artwork:

Pre-Marriage Heart Events

[spoiler]2 Hearts — “Computer and Coffee”

- Requirements: 2 hearts with Anton.
- Location: Anton's house.
- Time: 9:00 AM–12:00 PM.
- Weather and season: Any.
- Previous events: None.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_2HeartComputer_v1`

 3 Hearts — “Antivirus and Blueberry Tart”

- Requirements: 3 hearts with Anton and the 2-heart event completed.
- Location:Pierre's General Store.
- Day: Any day except Wednesday.
- Time: No separate restriction; the store must be accessible.
- Weather and season: Any.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_3HeartAntivirus_v1`

 4 Hearts — “Guitar”

- Requirements: 4 hearts with Anton and the 3-heart event completed.
- Location: the Mountain area.
- Time: 12:00–7:00 PM.
- Weather: Clear.
- Season: Spring, Summer, or Fall. The event cannot start in Winter.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_4HeartGuitar_v3`

 6 Hearts — “An Evening at the Saloon and the Stars”

- Requirements: 6 hearts with Anton and the 4-heart event completed.
- Location: the Stardrop Saloon.
- Day: Friday.
- Time: 6:00–11:00 PM.
- Weather: Clear.
- Season: Any.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_6HeartStars_v2`

8 Hearts — “Bracelet by the Lake”

- Requirements: 8 hearts with Anton and the 6-heart event completed.
- Invitation: Anton's note appears at the start of the day.
- Location: Anton's yard, by the lake near his house.
- Time: 6:00–11:00 PM.
- Weather: Clear.
- Season: Any.
- Reward: Anton's bracelet is added to the special items in your wallet.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_8HeartBracelet_v1`

 10 Hearts — “The Unpacked Box”

- Requirements: 10 hearts, dating Anton, and the 8-heart event completed.
- Invitation: Anton's letter arrives at the start of the day.
- Location: Anton's house.
- Time: 8:00–11:00 PM.
- Weather and season: Any.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_10HeartDate_v4`[/spoiler]

Special Pre-Marriage Event

[spoiler]The First Green Rain

- Requirements: Year 1 and Green Rain weather.
- Location: Anton's yard.
- Time: No separate restriction.
- Hearts and previous events: None.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_FirstGreenRain_v1`

This event is only available during the Green Rain in Year 1. If you miss that day, it won't appear in later years.[/spoiler]


 Post-Marriage Events

[spoiler]Morning Invitation to the Pier

- Requirements: Anton is your spouse and your relationship has reached 14 hearts.
- Location: the Farm, immediately after leaving the farmhouse.
- Time: 6:00 AM–12:00 PM.
- Weather: Clear or windy.
- Season: Any.
- Result: Unlocks the pier date for the same evening.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_14HeartPierInvite_v1`

Pier Date

- Requirements: Complete the morning invitation to the pier.
- Location: the Beach.
- Time: 8:00 PM–12:00 AM.
- Weather: Clear or windy.
- Season: Any.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_14HeartPier_v1`

“Power Outage”

- Requirements: Anton is your spouse and the pier date has been completed.
- Location: the farmhouse.
- Time: 7:00–11:00 PM.
- Weather: Rain.
- Day and season: Any.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_MarriagePowerOutage_v2`

“Game Night with Friends”

- Requirements: Anton is your spouse and the pier date has been completed.
- Location: the farmhouse.
- Day: Saturday.
- Time: 5:00–10:00 PM.
- Weather: Clear or windy.
- Season: Any.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_MarriageGameNight_v4`

 Morning Invitation to the Lake

- Requirements:
  - Anton is your spouse;
  - at least 12 hearts;
  - at least one in-game year has passed since the wedding — 112 days;
  - the pier date has been completed.
- Location: the Farm, immediately after leaving the farmhouse.
- Time: 6:00 AM–12:00 PM.
- Weather: Clear or windy.
- Season: Spring, Summer, or Fall. The invitation cannot appear in Winter.
- Result: Unlocks the lake date for the same evening.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_MarriageLakeStarsInvite_v1`

 “Stars over the Lake”

- Requirements: Complete the pier date and the morning lake invitation; have at least 12 hearts.
- Location: the Mountain lake.
- Time: 8:00 PM–12:00 AM.
- Weather: Clear or windy.
- Season: Spring, Summer, or Fall. The event cannot start in Winter.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_MarriageLakeStars_v1`

 Morning Invitation to the Secret Woods

- Requirements:
  - Anton is your spouse;
  - at least 12 hearts;
  - at least one in-game year has passed since the wedding — 112 days;
  - “Stars over the Lake” has been completed.
- Location: the Farm, immediately after leaving the farmhouse.
- Time: 6:00 AM–12:00 PM.
- Weather: Clear or windy.
- Season: Fall only.
- Result: Unlocks the Secret Woods photo session for the same day.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_MarriageWoodsPhotoInvite_v1`

 “Photo Session in the Secret Woods”

- Requirements: Complete the pier date, “Stars over the Lake,” and the morning woods invitation; have at least 12 hearts.
- Location: the Secret Woods.
- Time: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM.
- Weather: Clear or windy.
- Season: Fall only.
- Compatibility: with Stardew Valley Expanded installed, the actors use different positions, but the trigger conditions remain unchanged.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_MarriageWoodsPhoto_v1`

 “Family Album”

- Requirements: Anton is your spouse.
- Location: the farmhouse.
- Date: Winter 28.
- Time: 9:00 AM–8:00 PM.
- Weather: Any.
- Previous events: None.
- ID: `statilune.AntonNPCTest_FamilyAlbum_v1`[/spoiler]

After Marriage

Thursday

| Time | Anton's Location |

| 9:00 AM–3:00 PM | At Sam's house, using the computer |

| After 6:00 PM | Returns home |

Thursday in Summer, Fall, and Winter

| Time | Anton's Location |

| After 6:00 PM | Returns home |

With Stardew Valley Expanded installed, Anton's exact tile at the Railroad changes, but the time and purpose of the route remain the same.

Friday

| Time | Anton's Location |

| Before 6:00 PM | On the farm |
| 6:00–10:00 PM | At the Stardrop Saloon |

Saturday

| Time | Anton's Location |

| After 8:00 PM | Returns home |
| After 10:00 PM | Goes to bed |

Summer 4 After Marriage

Anton stays on the farm until 3:00 PM, then returns to the bedroom.

The mod doesn't define a separate rainy-day route after marriage. During the remaining hours, Anton follows standard at-home spouse behavior.

Special Seasonal Events

These routes replace Anton's normal schedule for the corresponding day.

| Day | Before Marriage | After Marriage |

| Desert Festival, days 1–3 | In the Desert from 8:30 AM until midnight | In the Desert from 8:30 AM until midnight |
| Summer 20 and 21 | By the forest river from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, then returns to his computer | Follows spouse behavior unless the festival provides another route |
| Winter 12 and 13 | At the beach from 2:00 to 9:00 PM, then returns to his computer | Follows spouse behavior unless the festival provides another route |
| Night Market, Winter 15–17 | At the beach from 4:30 to 11:30 PM | At the beach from 4:30 to 11:30 PM |

During regular calendar festivals, Anton appears directly on the festival map. His position may differ between the first and later years, and when Stardew Valley Expanded is installed.[/spoiler]
